question.text:
The knee-jerk reflex is classified as:

• (A) Voluntary action
• (B) Involuntary action
• (C) Learned reflex
• (D) Conditioned reflex

Why are reflex actions classified as involuntary?

  (A) They occur without involving sensory neurons.

  (B) They always involve the brain in decision-making.

 (C) They are fast responses that do not require conscious thought.

 (D) They only happen in response to voluntary movements.
